thesis: Hold. Sizing book is $1000 cash and zero positions, so this hour is an entry only. The completed policy item is a $60 billion US-China tariff cut on narrow goods such as dolls and fireworks; the same report says rare earths are unresolved and there was no breakthrough on AI, Iran, or Taiwan, and it names no ticker. MongoDB's CEO leaving to run a new Meta enterprise-platform effort is a real corporate item and it is negative for MongoDB; the headline already states the stock is down nearly 20%, so that reaction is described rather than unpriced, and one outside hire is not enough to open Meta. Micron and Nvidia items are an earnings preview and a valuation opinion, not reported results. Carryover from 9/27 still has the rally straining under elevated oil, rising Treasury yields, and a Fed bracing for more hikes. Starship reached orbit with the flight cut short, and SpaceX is not a listed equity. SEC filings are trusts, votes, officer items, and undetailed 8-Ks; politician PTRs name no symbols. No orders.
